description_en: Queries the run records of a specified metadata crawler by paging, with optional filtering by time range and run status
description_zh: 分页查询指定元数据采集器的运行记录，并可按时间范围和运行状态筛选
name: ListCrawlerRuns

parameters.help_en: The ID of the metadata crawler. You can call ListCrawlers to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 元数据采集器 ID。您可以通过 ListCrawlers 查询
parameters.name: id

parameters.help_en: The lower bound of the run start time, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp. The value must be within the last 30 days. If not specified, the default value is 30 days before the current time
parameters.help_zh: 运行开始时间下界，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳。取值必须位于最近 30 天内；未传入时默认为当前时间前 30 天
parameters.name: start_time_from

parameters.help_en: The upper bound of the run start time, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp. The value must be within the last 30 days. If not specified, the default value is the current time
parameters.help_zh: 运行开始时间上界，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳。取值必须位于最近 30 天内；未传入时默认为当前时间
parameters.name: start_time_to

parameters.help_en: The run status. Valid values: WAITING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, ERROR, SHUTDOWN
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码，从 1 开始，默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页条目数，默认值为 20，最大值为 100
parameters.name: page_size

CrawlerRuns.description_en: The list of metadata crawler run records
CrawlerRuns.description_zh: 元数据采集器运行记录列表

items.description_en: A single metadata crawler run record
items.description_zh: 单次元数据采集器运行记录

FinishedTime.description_en: The end time, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
FinishedTime.description_zh: 结束时间，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳
FinishedTime.title_zh: 结束时间，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳

StartedTime.description_en: The start time, in millisecond-level UNIX timestamp
StartedTime.description_zh: 开始时间，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳
StartedTime.title_zh: 开始时间，毫秒级 Unix 时间戳

Status.description_en: The run status. Valid values: WAITING, RUNNING, SUCCESS, ERROR, SHUTDOWN

TaskInstanceId.description_en: The DataWorks task instance ID associated with this run
TaskInstanceId.description_zh: 本次运行关联的 DataWorks 任务实例 ID

TotalTableCount.description_en: The total number of tables involved in this run
TotalTableCount.description_zh: 本次运行涉及的表总数
TotalTableCount.title_zh: 本次运行涉及的表总数

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合查询条件的记录总数
TotalCount.title_zh: 符合条件的运行记录总数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Used for locating logs and troubleshooting issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID。用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
